subject: NebulaWorks integration sprint — compatibility checklist & marketplace next steps
messages:
From: Sam Nguyen <sam@nebulaworks.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: NebulaWorks x Redwood — demo recap and next steps

Hi Aisha / Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — really helpful to see Redwoods runtime optimizations in action. A few quick asks from our side so we can scope an integration sprint on our end: 

- Can you share a compatibility checklist for LangChain and LlamaIndex adapters so our engineers can map our existing code paths?
- Wed like to confirm tracing semantics (how to correlate Nebula traces with Redwood request IDs). Is there a small spec we can use?
- Marketplace listing: what assets + partner badge requirements do you need and what is the timeline?

Attaching the demo recording for internal reference (nebula-demo-recording.mp4). If you can send a mutual action plan / checklist well propose internal resources and dates.

Sam Nguyen
Head of Integrations, NebulaWorks
sam@nebulaworks.ai
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Nguyen <sam@nebulaworks.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 13:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NebulaWorks x Redwood — demo recap and next steps

Sam, thanks — great to meet you earlier.

Weve sketched a short mutual action plan below and attached a pre-filled compatibility checklist template (interop-checklist-template.xlsx) to make scoping faster. Proposal: 3-week technical sprint + 1 week QA/marketplace readiness. High-level milestones:

1) Week 0 (prep): share sample queries, dataset sizes, and target latency SLOs (you)
2) Week 1-2 (engineering): LangChain connector + LlamaIndex loader validation + tracing hook integration (Redwood eng + Nebula eng)
3) Week 3 (interop testing): end-to-end traces, token/cost measurement, error handling
4) Week 4 (marketplace): assets, security checklist, partner badge application (marketing + partnerships)

Can you confirm: which SDKs youll prioritize (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or both) and who from your engineering team will be the point? Weve looped Karthik to scope the tracing/SDK work.

Next steps: Ill schedule a 30-min sprint kickoff for early next week after you confirm resources.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
aisha_rahman@redwood.ai
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Nguyen <sam@nebulaworks.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NebulaWorks x Redwood — demo recap and next steps (technical scope)

Folks — quick tech note from the infra side so we have clear acceptance criteria for the sprint. Ive attached a short tracing spec (tracing-hooks-spec.md). Key points: 

- SDK coverage: we can support both LangChain (Python/JS connectors) and LlamaIndex (node + python loaders). Expect ~2 engineer-days per connector for initial adapter wiring and basic end-to-end tests.
- Tracing: Redwood will emit per-request header X-Redwood-Request-Id and include a trace context header X-RW-Trace. For Nebula correlation we ask that requests include your x-request-id or nebula-request-id so we can stitch traces on our side. The attached spec lists the headers and example payloads.
- Performance gating: for production we recommend a baseline test with 5k tokens/session, median latency target < 250ms for 8k context (depends on model). Please confirm your workload percentiles (p50/p95) and typical sequence lengths.
- Security: if you need a private deployment (VPC) for data residency we can add a Dedicated offering; let us know.

Ill be available in the kickoff to pair on trace validation.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer, Senior Software Engineer (Runtime) | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
From: Sam Nguyen <sam@nebulaworks.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NebulaWorks x Redwood — demo recap and next steps

Thanks Aisha and Karthik — this is exactly what we needed. Quick confirmations from Nebula: 

- Well pursue both LangChain and LlamaIndex connectors concurrently.
- Our infra lead Priya Shah (cc: nebula-infra-eng@nebulaworks.ai) will join the kickoff; shell share a brief doc with our typical sequence lengths and 95th percentile latency targets by EOD today.
- Marketplace: Nebula approves Redwoods partner badge and we can supply logos + 1 pager once the sprint completes.

We accepted the HubSpot proposal and signed the NDAs; Im attaching the DocuSign procurement link here: https://www.docusign.com/NEB-Redwood-Partner-Agreement

Look forward to the kickoff — Sam

Sam Nguyen
Head of Integrations, NebulaWorks
sam@nebulaworks.ai
